transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Hannah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm absolutely livid. I've just found out you've been charging me for a landline I cancelled in March. That's seven months of money you've taken from me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, Kwabena. Paying for seven months for something you cancelled is completely unacceptable, and I completely understand why you're angry. I'm going to look into it right now and put it right.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I should hope so.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you answer the security question on the account for me: the name of your first pet?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Biscuit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. So you cancelled the landline in March, and you've still been billed for it every month since then. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes. Twelve pounds a month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you get a cancellation confirmation at the time, by email or letter?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I got an email, I've still got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's really helpful. Does it have a reference number at the top, starting with CN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, CN 4 4 0 9 1.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I can see that cancellation, and I can see where it went wrong: the request was logged but never sent through to billing. That's our error, entirely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So what are you going to do about it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm cancelling the line on the billing system right now, and I'm refunding all seven months, that's eighty-four pounds, back to your card. I'm also adding a ten-pound goodwill credit because you shouldn't have had to find this yourself.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Thank you. That's more like it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The refund will show on your card in three to five working days. Would you like me to email you a breakdown so you can check it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sent. Could you check that it's arrived, and that it shows the line as cancelled?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's here. Says line cancelled and refund of eighty-four pounds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. So the landline is properly cancelled now, the refund is on its way, and the credit is applied. Is there anything about this that you're still unhappy with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, you've sorted it. Thanks Hannah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Kwabena. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and have a good day.
